summary: Implemented a default-OFF executable local ribbon evidence recipe and CLI using exact existing Dev72 learner/observer and JS profile/widthSearchAt/edgePairOf. Explicit frame, finite geometry and raw RGBA SHA checks fail closed. Retains raw learner rows, every station/candidate channel, profile visibility and edge fit. Actual finite paired fits expose signed midpoint offsets; missing pairs remain UNKNOWN. Width calibration and semantic identity always UNKNOWN; promoted=false. No production source or existing evidence changed. Candidate source frozen before independent evaluation, which C6 has not read.
